talent.basilisk: On position 5, every card of the other player's that can be destroyed leaves the battlefield once the fight is over, and so does the Basilisk.
talent.beast-kid: Draw a card from a stack: its power alone is the Beast Kid's power for this fight.  The drawn card is thrown away afterwards.
talent.beholder: Position 1: flying.  Position 2: destroying.  Position 3: shooting.  Position 4: 1 more power.  Position 5: 1 less.
talent.bembi: If the Bembi loses to a fire card, take 4 extra points and throw the Bembi away.
talent.carrot-knight: Gains 4 power if the card opposite has an even power.
talent.cole-sage: Takes 2 extra points if he wins his fight.
talent.dark-warlord: Gains 2 power for every spirit card still face down on the battlefield.
talent.dragon: A card with the shooting ability holds the Dragon to a draw.
talent.druid: Draw a card from a stack: if its face is earth, the Druid gains 4 power.  The drawn card is thrown away afterwards.
talent.elemental: Gains 1 power for every card of its own element face up on the battlefield, counting the card opposite but never itself.
talent.energy-knight: Gains 5 power on position {position}, and nothing anywhere else.
talent.gnomeling: Beats any non-fire card of power 9 or more, flying or not.
talent.hill-dwarf: Takes 1 extra point if he wins his fight, and is thrown away if he loses it.
talent.indestructible: Cannot be destroyed.  Takes 1 extra point from a card with the destroying ability.
talent.ki-rin: After the duel, if the Ki-Rin survived, draw a card: power 1 to 7 takes 1 extra point, and 8 or more throws the Ki-Rin away.
talent.melody: Gains 2 power for every non-elemental card on the battlefield, face up or face down, except herself.
talent.mercy-twister: Before anything else, the card opposite is thrown away and replaced from a stack of the Mercy Twister's owner's choosing.
talent.necromancer: Before anything else, the card opposite is exchanged for the top card of the graveyard.  A Necromancer who loses his fight is thrown away.
talent.ogre-mage: Before anything else, and only once, a card opposite of power 8 or less is exchanged for the top card of the graveyard.
talent.otter-warrior: Gains 8 power against a water card.
talent.sorcerer-apprentice: Takes 1 extra point if he wins his fight.
talent.swap: Changes sides with the card opposite once the duel is over, even if it was destroyed first.
talent.troll: Gains 1 power on position 2, 2 on position 3, 3 on position 4, and 4 on position 5.
talent.zurubang: Beats every card, except any card with power 4 or less.  Cannot be destroyed.  A Zurubang that loses is thrown away, and the card that beat it takes 1 extra point.

entry.intro: A duelling card game for two.  Your card backs are on show the whole time; your card faces never are.
